stable.notes: 0.48.0 - everything since 0.43.0: splices (part, instances, node editor, DRC rule); wire cross section in mm2 with program units for cross section, length and diameter; cable conductor and shield diameter; new menu structure; Design Rule Check engine with waivers and legend; autosave and recovery; Place menu; BOM grouped by connector; custom terminals; hover and scroll never edit a cell.

beta.notes: Label printing: Build → Print Labels… (harness wrap label, box label, wire label per node; one print job per label) and File → Settings… → Label printer. Node dialog: one Add menu, Fill Blanks / Connector tool menus; Remove Connection takes every selected row. Parts Database asks before unsaved edits are lost; transparent connector photos; the program opens maximized.
